sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Fayette Historic State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21 alike): 50 20/30-amp sites $37, 11 50-amp pull-through sites $42. The DNR's 2026 table: $35 (20/30-amp) / $40 (50-amp) modern, $30 / $35 semi-modern (the booking site's rate for 2026-10-27, after the toilet/shower building closes Oct. 18). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($37 / $42 on 2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21; $30 / $35 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Fayette Campground: 50-amp $40, 20/30-amp $35, semi-modern $35 / $30; toilet/shower building May 15 to Oct. 18) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fayette ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fayette ('All sites have 20/30-amp service, and pull-through sites have 20/30/ 50-amp service') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (all 61 sites 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 11 with 50 Amps), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Three loops; most sites moderate in size and shaded by maple and cedar. The 11 50-amp sites are the pull-throughs and take trailers/RVs to 50 ft; the other 50 sites range from 20 to 40 ft (two tent-only).

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fayette ('The modern campground is divided into three loops. Most sites are moderate in size'; 'Number of sites: 61'; tag 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com resources (allowed equipment up to 'Trailer or RV up to 50'' on the 11 50-amp sites, 20-40 ft on the rest), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Sanitation station between the contact station and the campground. Free WiFi in the modern campground. Toilet/shower building open May 15 to Oct. 18 (DNR 2026 table).

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fayette (campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station', 'Concession or store', 'WiFi'; 'The park's sanitation station is located between the contact station and the modern campground'; 'Free WiFi is available at the historic townsite, visitor center and modern campground') + DNR rates table (modern toilet/shower building May 15 to Oct. 18), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fayette ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + midnrreservations.com (reservation season May 15 - November 29 in the DNR 2026 table), read 2026-10-25

note: Modern state park campground near the historic Fayette townsite (1867-1891 iron-smelting town) on Big Bay de Noc (Lake Michigan), Garden Peninsula UP. A short path at the end of each loop leads to the bay; the townsite is a short walk north. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table: 61 sites in three loops, 20/30-amp on all and 50-amp on the 11 pull-throughs (RVs to 50 ft, max_rig_ft new), electric only; showers/flush and vault toilets/sanitation station/store/WiFi; reservable on MiDNRReservations. Fees 30-40 (2026 table) -> 37-42 (2027 booking site; 2026 and semi-modern rates in fees.note). Season (derived year_round false) left: only the reservation season (May 15 - Nov 29) and toilet-building dates are published. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Phone: the entry has none; the DNR park page lists 906-644-2603.
